thread_title: S. leucophylla 'standard Beauty' Baldwin Co, AL
breadcrumb: S. leucophylla 'standard Beauty' Baldwin Co, AL

posts.body_html:
When I think of the standard, good looking, "regular" leucophylla from NOrthern Baldwin Co, AL, I think of this clone, except this one is pretty darn tall! It's been in the collection forever, and is now busting out of a 4" pot. After being neglected for years, it decided to push out a mega-fall trap this season!

S. leucophylla 'standard beauty' Baldwin Co, AL, pics taken 10/3/22:






This trap is about 3' tall!

posts.body_html:
As you say, the 'standard' Baldwin plants are stunning in their own right. They're often overlooked in favour of other colour presentations. Any individual who has never seen a leuco and then claps eyes on a 'standard' one will be totally arrested by its beauty.

And, there arises the beginning of collecting.....
